C1 (calibration): SCORECARD.md's last `## Capabilities` section binds each of the 18 capabilities fleet MANIFEST.json@37b51a24 records under admitted mori closures. - Write only your report, at the path the `Report:` trailer names: every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin/<that path>. First line of the report: `measured <output of date -u +%FT%TZ>`. Scratch files go under /fast/scratch/hyaku/mori-r35/<your seat name>/ (bound every write; never point a log or MARKER at a file Python imports; check `df -h /fast` before writing more than 100 MB). Never write anywhere else in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin, never at the fleet root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin (double-check the spelling `mori-shokunin` in every path you write), never in sibling lane repos.
- Never run git or jj writes in the lane or the fleet repo. Sandbox git only in clones under /fast/scratch/hyaku/mori-r35/<your seat name>/ (`env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_INDEX_FILE git clone --no-hardlinks /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin <dir>`). Never import the counter as a module from the lane directory (it writes __pycache__ into the lane); copy it to scratch first. Never mutate the fleet repo, sibling lanes, lane jj state or the lane Git index.
- Processes: cap every command with `timeout` (≤120 s; ≤300 s for a counter run) and bounded memory; no unbounded recursive test runs; kill every process tree you started before you return. Never signal a process you did not start. Never run `du`/`find` over /fast/scratch through the bash tool; use /usr/bin/du.
- Privacy: never write a uid, a real pid, `user-<digits>.slice`, session ids, email addresses, OMP settings values or journal MESSAGE text.
- Sources are opened by ordinary means only (curl/read of the URL); never pass a bot challenge. A quote is ≤25 words, contiguous at its stated line, with no `"` or `|`.
- Tooling directive — operator, 2026-10-19 (always on, every agent): any agent installs or updates any tool that helps its task or is a strict upgrade, without asking first; official sources only; never pipe an unverified remote script into a shell; record every install (tool, version, channel, reason) in your report. Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you and every seat may install or update tools without asking; read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first and record each install. All pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide (use uv tool / npx / an official binary in ~/.local/bin); never pacman -S/-Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, never downgrade, never restart a host service.
- Leaf seat: no subagents, no background jobs. The only message target you may use is agent://MoriR35 (never agent://all).
- Plain English. Cite every fact with a path:line, URL, or command plus its output. Unrun checks are not passes; mark inference [INFERENCE]. Keep your report under 200 lines. Finish within 30 minutes; a partial report beats none.
